source: docs/specs/04_mechanics/zols_mistake.md. Every number is the spec's proposal. Names are resolved to tags through data/countries.json. No text names a servant, a keeper of Furviatlon or what feeding is.

ideas.name: Without a Body
ideas.desc: The Old God has no body in Aoaz and cannot take one. What he commands, he commands from the dark, through those who serve.

ideas.name: The Dormancy
ideas.desc: The north is quiet, as it has been for an age. The dead stir in the islands and the living do not hear.

ideas.name: The Rising
ideas.desc: The dead have come out of the north. Nothing the living have built was made for them.

ideas.name: The Form Taken
ideas.desc: For a short while the Old God stands in Aoaz with a shape. It costs more than he can pay for long.

ideas.name: Wounded, Not Slain
ideas.desc: He withdrew into the dark of his domain. He was wounded, and constrained, and he was not slain.

ideas.name: The Dead Endure
ideas.desc: A breath of the Old God's will goes through the host. Broken ranks stand and the fallen rise.

ideas.name: The Bane of the Potent
ideas.desc: Weapons that carry old power can end what ordinary iron cannot. The dead press harder against those who bear them.

ideas.name: The Bane Known
ideas.desc: The hosts have learned where the potent blades stand and how to meet them. The dead press less blindly.

ideas.name: Forewarned of Black Ships
ideas.desc: Someone sent a ship to look when the fishermen spoke of black hulls. The crown that did so has not been surprised since.

zin_zol_presence.name: The Presence
zin_zol_presence.desc: How much of the Old God's presence can act in Aoaz. Not his whole power, which no one has measured.

zin_zol_black_waste.name: The Black Wastes
zin_zol_black_waste.desc: Nothing grows and nothing is easy to cross. The dead walk it without hunger.

zin_zol_deathfield.name: The Land Made Waste
zin_zol_deathfield.desc: Where the form stood, the land is dead for years: the soil gives nothing, and nothing wants to stay.
